Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Shortpilot runway — request for short extension

Hi Ben,

Quick one — our security review hit a new gating item (IDP token rotation) and it looks like engineering will need an extra two weeks before we can complete the integration tests.

We still want to complete the shortpilot but the current 21-day timebox will expire before we can finish. Can Redwood extend the pilot by 14 days? If an extension needs to be paid for, we can consider either a small top-up or a credit against future consumption. Also open to a one-off discount if that makes administrative sense.

We can share the latest test logs (attached) and will run the final acceptance test as soon as onboarding is fixed. Appreciate any quick guidance — we need to update our procurement lead today.

Thanks,
Aisha
Principal Product Manager
SageWind Analytics
(Attachment: sagewind-usage-report.csv)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Shortpilot runway — request for short extension

Hi Aisha — thanks for the update and for sending the logs. Totally understand the gating work.

A couple of quick options we can put on the table today:
- Option A: 14-day extension at no additional charge if SageWind schedules a final acceptance/decision meeting within the extended window.
- Option B: 14-day extension via a $5k token voucher (applies to billed usage during the pilot) + a 10% one-time credit on first-month post-conversion consumption.

I'm looping Markus here to confirm we can approve Option B as a standard one-time concession. If Option A is preferable, I can confirm and send a simple addendum.

Which would you prefer? I can draft the addendum/DocuSign link once you tell me which path you want.

Best,
Ben Carter

Ben — thanks for looping me in.

I think Option B is reasonable as a scaled concession for this stage of the funnel. My suggested guardrails:
- Offer a one-time voucher equal to $5,000 of billable token value redeemable during the pilot (non-transferable).
- Include a 10% credit applied to the first-month invoice post-conversion, capped at $8,000.
- Extension language should be limited to 14 days with an explicit acceptance milestone (final acceptance call scheduled + recording).

Finance/legal: please note we need a brief addendum (DocuSign) attaching these terms and a clause that this is a single-use concession and does not change SLA or payment terms.

Ben — if you get a thumb up from Kimberly, prepare the addendum and push the DocuSign link. I'll approve the voucher code from ops once legal signs off.
